lone_druid_spirit_bear.name: Summon Spirit Bear
lone_druid_spirit_bear.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.description:
Summons a mighty spirit bear.

The bear cannot attack if the distance to its owner exceeds %distance_silence%. If the bear dies, the hero takes damage equal to %backlash_damage%%% of their maximum health.\nThe bear has no attributes and cannot carry items.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note0: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note1: Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note2: Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note3: Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note4: Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Increases the distance from Lone Druid at which the Spirit Bear can attack.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.return_description: Channels for %channel_tooltip% seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.return_scepter_description: Allows Spirit Bear to attack at any range from Lone Druid, and to survive if Lone Druid dies.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_description:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply %spirit_bear_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note0: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note1: Enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note2: Stacks are only applied to enemy heroes, creep heroes, and Roshan.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.demolish_description: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.spirit_link_description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.spirit_link_lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.fetch_description: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every %tick_rate%s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

lone_druid_entangle.name: Entangle
lone_druid_entangle.description:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
lone_druid_entangle.scepter_description: Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
lone_druid_entangle.note0: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
lone_druid_entangle.note1: Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
lone_druid_entangle.note3: Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
lone_druid_entangle.note4: Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.

lone_druid_spirit_link.name: Spirit Link
lone_druid_spirit_link.description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lone_druid_spirit_link.facet_lone_druid_bear_with_me: Shared Armor increased. Damage dealt by either the Spirit Bear or Lone Druid will heal the other.
lone_druid_spirit_link.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Only damage dealt by Spirit Bear heals Lone Druid.
lone_druid_spirit_link.scepter_description:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for %duration%s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by %active_bonus%%%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.
lone_druid_spirit_link.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

lone_druid_savage_roar.name: Savage Roar
lone_druid_savage_roar.lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.
lone_druid_savage_roar.description: Hero and his bear let out a savage roar, causing enemies to flee in terror. The movement speed of affected units is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
lone_druid_savage_roar.bear_description: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
lone_druid_savage_roar.shard_description:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lone_druid_savage_roar.note0: Cooldown of the hero and the bear is the same.
lone_druid_savage_roar.bear_note0: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
lone_druid_savage_roar.note1: Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
lone_druid_savage_roar.bear_note1: Cooldown is shared with Lone Druid.

lone_druid_true_form.name: True Form
lone_druid_true_form.lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.
lone_druid_true_form.description: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
lone_druid_true_form.facet_lone_druid_bear_with_me: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining increased bonus armor, more health, and improved versions of Entangling Claws and Demolish.
lone_druid_true_form.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Lone Druid morphs his Spirit Bear into an enraged form that gains bonus armor, attack speed, demolish damage, and a %entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% cooldown on Entangling Claws.
lone_druid_true_form.note0: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Lone Druid was in when the item was used.
